audit_type: independent preliminary source audit; no question-bank access
scope: Unmatched: Battle of Legends Volume One (2019), standard two-player duel, original Alice/King Arthur/Medusa/Sinbad character cards and all 120 base action cards; excludes team play, later sets, Adventures and later rulings
verdict_reason: The summary gives incorrect shared-card BOOST values and assigns BOOST 1 to six original Voyage cards that have no printed BOOST value. These affect movement and boosted attacks. No other definite material rules error or important omission was found. The original rulebook does not expressly resolve the eligibility of a card with no printed BOOST value as a BOOST payment.

findings.summary_ref: Card reference > Shared cards > Feint: ANY; V/2; B2 (Arthur B1)

source_refs.location: 6-column by 5-row sheet, row 5 columns 1, 2 and 3, each circled BOOST numeral 1

findings.actual: Sinbad Feint has BOOST 1. Alice and Medusa Feint have BOOST 2; Arthur Feint has BOOST 1.
findings.impact: A Sinbad Feint discarded to maneuver BOOST would incorrectly allow every surviving fighter one extra space.
findings.required_correction: Specify Feint B2 for Alice/Medusa and B1 for Arthur/Sinbad.

findings.summary_ref: Card reference > Shared cards > Regroup: ANY; V/1; B2
findings.claim: Regroup has BOOST 2 in all four decks.

source_refs.location: row 5 columns 4, 5 and 6, each circled BOOST numeral 1
row 5 columns 4, 5 and 6, each circled BOOST numeral 1

findings.actual: Arthur and Sinbad Regroup have BOOST 1. Alice and Medusa Regroup have BOOST 2.
findings.impact: Incorrectly increases Arthur/Sinbad maneuver allowance by one when discarding Regroup, and Arthur attack value by one when Regroup boosts his attack through his ability or Noble Sacrifice.
findings.required_correction: Specify Regroup B2 for Alice/Medusa and B1 for Arthur/Sinbad.

findings.summary_ref: Sinbad > All 7 Voyage cards are Sinbad-only A/2, B1, one copy each
findings.claim: All seven Voyages have printed BOOST 1.

source_refs.location: row 2 columns 5–6; row 3 columns 1–4; these six Voyage cards lack a visible circled BOOST number. Voyage Home at row 1 column 5 visibly has B1.

findings.actual: Voyage Home has a printed circled BOOST 1. The other six original Voyage cards have no printed BOOST icon or numeral. This is a positive component feature, not obscured/corrupted text.
findings.impact: The summary invents a numerical value for six cards and invites using them as BOOST 1 payments.
findings.required_correction: State that only Voyage Home has printed B1, and that the other six Voyage cards have no printed BOOST value. Do not assign them B0 or B1.

unresolved_source_gaps.summary_ref: BOOST movement and Sinbad card reference
unresolved_source_gaps.issue: Original rulebook p10 describes discarding a card and adding that card’s BOOST value. It does not expressly state whether a card with no printed BOOST value may be discarded as the payment at all. The six non-Home original Voyages positively have no printed BOOST icon/numeral; their images are complete. Rejecting them as BOOST payments follows the described numerical operation but is not separately stated as an explicit exception in the supplied original rulebook.

unresolved_source_gaps.resolution_needed: If an explicit ruling about payment eligibility is required, obtain an authorized original publisher clarification. Do not import fan or later rulings into this closed audit.
unresolved_source_gaps.interpretation_boundary: No printed BOOST value is directly established; cannot pay BOOST is a reasonable inference from p10, not an explicit rule sentence in these sources.
